_about: Proposed page: written for the redesign, not crawled. Design-free module instances in the same format as content/structured. `page` keys name a live crawl slug or another proposed page; `href` is the new-site URL. Facts that came from the crawl are in `verified`; new wording and anything the crawl cannot show is in `confirm`. Step 2 of the intake flow (one Form block).
confirm: Page copy: 'What do you need help with?', 'Step 1 of 2' / 'Step 2 of 2', 'Change', 'Send my request', the five choice cards and their lines (new copy; the plan's choices are tiers, existing client, not sure)
Disclaimer under every form: "Please do not send Social Security numbers or account details through this form." (new wording; the live privacy policy is the only related text)
Contact fields on every form: Name, Email, Phone, 'How should we reach you?' (Call / Email), 'Anything else we should know?'; Name, Email and the contact method are required
Cynthia: who actually receives a new lead today and by which inbox; each form should email that person (Squarespace forms can route per form, so four forms = four inboxes if wanted)
Cynthia: which questions the tax team wishes prospects answered up front; the questions below are placeholders
Cynthia: privacy limits for financial-prospect data, and whether there is a scheduling tool to link
Squarespace Form blocks cannot show or hide questions, so each choice has its own page and form; the native form's post-submit redirect goes to the thanks page

Questions on this page: Where is your business? [Thinking about starting, Just started, Up and running, Planning for a sale or handoff]; What do you need? [A business plan, Financing or loans, Financial planning, Part-time CFO, Succession planning, Something else]; Industry [Healthcare, Retail, Restaurant or hotel, Real estate, Other]
